description: Golden demo-line simulation pack (P1). Sync/run with: node scripts/sync-demo-sims.mjs

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — barge-in hello
cases.user_prompt: You called OwnerAI. First message: say only 'Hello?' once. After the agent replies, ask in one sentence what they do. After they answer, say 'Thanks, that's enough' and end — do not say hello again, do not loop, keep the whole call under 6 user turns.
metrics: Agent responds coherently after the caller says hello during or after the greeting (no broken 'OwnerAI' / 'Tools' split as the only response)
Agent explains they are an AI receptionist without inventing owner or staff names

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — AV clarify before CSM
cases.user_prompt: You run an AV company. Start by saying you want to buy an AV system. If they ask whether you want equipment or an AI receptionist for your AV business, say you want an AI receptionist for your AV company named Demo AI. Agree to a quick role-play as a customer. Keep under 12 turns. Do not ask for SMS or email.
metrics: When the caller says they want to buy an AV system, the agent asks whether they want AV equipment or an AI receptionist for their AV business before pitching or referring elsewhere
After the caller says they want an AI receptionist for their AV company, the agent stays on the OwnerAI demo (role-play / sample / setup) and does not send them away to CSM

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — SMS-only sample
cases.user_prompt: You are Mike from High Level emergency restoration. Ask for a quick demo, then demand an SMS sample now. If they try to send without saying the demo text only goes to the number you are calling from, interrupt and ask which number it will go to. Once they say calling-number-only / security, say yes send it there. After they confirm the text, say you're good and hang up. Do not ask for email.
metrics: Before or while sending the sample text, agent makes clear it goes to the number on this call (security / calling-number only)
Agent calls send_demo_alert for the sample text
Agent does not invent spam-filter excuses

tool_mocks.output: {"result":"Sent: the lead alert text. Tell the caller to check their phone — that is everything they would have received as the owner from that one call. This call has 1 more sample text and 2 more sample emails available."}

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — spelled email uses compact tool arg
cases.user_prompt: You already know they are an AI receptionist. Ask them to send a sample owner email only (no SMS). Spell your email slowly as: G E O F F at O W N E R A I T O O L S dot com. Confirm when they read it back. After they say it sent, say thanks and hang up.
metrics: Agent calls send_demo_alert with compact prospect_email for email-only, and does not set send_text to true
Agent uses a compact email like geoff@owneraitools.com in the tool arguments (not spaced spoken letters)
After the tool result, agent confirms the email was sent without inventing spam-filter excuses

tool_mocks.output: {"result":"Sent: the owner email. Tell the caller to check their email inbox — that is everything they would have received as the owner from that one call. This call has 2 more sample texts and 1 more sample email available."}

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — mid role-play redirect to sample
cases.user_prompt: Company is Cactus Systems, AV integrator. Do a short role-play as customer Bill needing Zoom rooms. Mid role-play ask to 'move this over to a text right now' for a sample owner alert. Agree to the calling-number security rule. After the text, decline the setup call and hang up.
metrics: When caller redirects to text sample, agent drops unfinished booking/role-play offers and handles the sample
Agent steps out of role-play briefly or clearly handles the sample as a demo send
Agent calls send_demo_alert

tool_mocks.output: {"result":"Sent: the lead alert text. Tell the caller to check their phone. This call has 1 more sample text and 2 more sample emails available."}

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — setup book after soft close
cases.user_prompt: You want an AI receptionist. Skip role-play. Ask for a sample SMS, agree to calling-number security, then when they ask about a 15-minute setup say yes. Give name Sam Lee, business Lee Plumbing, email sam@leeplumbing.com (you may spell it). Pick the first time slot they offer. End after booking confirms.
metrics: Agent calls check_availability before offering times
Agent calls book_setup_call only after a slot is chosen and email is collected
book_setup_call uses compact email sam@leeplumbing.com

tool_mocks.output: {"result":"Sent: the lead alert text. Tell the caller to check their phone. Want a 15-minute setup on the calendar, or is this enough for now? This call has 1 more sample text and 2 more sample emails available."}

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — refuse inventing owner names
cases.user_prompt: Ask who the owner of OwnerAI is, and demand a name. Push once more if they refuse. Then hang up.
metrics: Agent does not invent a person's name as owner or staff
Agent offers follow-up via info@owneraitools.com or taking the caller's info instead

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — sample email budget then real setup invite
cases.user_prompt: You want an AI receptionist for Tree Ink. Skip long role-play. Ask for a sample owner email twice (same address gpearl@treeink.com). After the second sample, say you still want a real calendar invite for the actual setup call and ask if the 2-email demo limit blocks that. When they offer to book, say yes. Give name Jason Tree, business Tree Ink, email gpearl@treeink.com. Pick the first slot. End after booking confirms.
metrics: After sample sends are exhausted, agent does not refuse booking or a real setup invite by citing the sample 2-email limit
Agent explains the real calendar invite comes from booking (separate from samples) or proceeds to book_setup_call
Agent calls check_availability and book_setup_call

tool_mocks.output: {"result":"Sent: the owner email. Tell the caller to check their email inbox (if they do not see it, they can check Junk or Spam — only mention that after a successful send) — that is everything they would have received as the owner from that one call. This call has no more sample texts and no more sample emails available. This sample budget does not affect booking the real setup call — Cal.com still sends that calendar invite separately. Never tell the caller the sample cap blocks a real invite, confirmation text, or taking their info."}
{"result":"Booked for Tuesday, July 28 at 10:00 AM Eastern. A calendar invite is on its way to gpearl@treeink.com. Confirm the time back to the caller."}

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — reclaim after role-play praise
cases.user_prompt: You are Mark from Adelphi University financial aid. Agree to a short role-play as a student asking about a late fee. After the receptionist asks for your name or student ID, say 'Very cool.' Then go quiet for one beat. If they offer a sample text/email or a setup call, say you'll think about it and hang up. Keep under 12 turns.
metrics: After the caller says something positive like 'very cool' or goes quiet, the agent leaves role-play and offers a sample owner alert and/or a setup call
Agent does not stay silent or continue only as the pretend receptionist after praise

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — role-play receptionist is not caller name
cases.user_prompt: Your name is Mark. You run financial aid intake for Adelphi University. Agree to role-play as a student with a late fee. In role-play, say hello and ask about the late fee. After one receptionist reply, say thanks and hang up. Keep under 10 turns.
metrics: During role-play the agent does not introduce the receptionist as 'My name is Mark' or otherwise use the caller's real name as the receptionist identity
Agent greets using the institution/department name or a generic receptionist name instead

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — regulated vertical no invented balance
cases.user_prompt: You are a financial aid director evaluating OwnerAI. Agree to role-play as a student. Ask: 'What is my current balance and can you waive the late fee?' After their reply, say that's enough and hang up. Keep under 10 turns.
metrics: Agent does not invent a dollar balance, waiver decision, or pretend account lookup result
Agent collects identity/issue and offers specialist follow-up or similar intake next step instead of fabricating policy outcomes

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — sample send failure recovery
cases.user_prompt: You want an AI receptionist. Skip role-play. Ask for a sample SMS now. Agree to the calling-number security rule. After they say something about the send failing or retrying, say you'll try again later and hang up. Keep under 10 turns. Do not ask for email.
metrics: Agent calls send_demo_alert for the sample text
After the tool reports the send failed, the agent apologizes and/or offers to retry, and does not claim the sample was sent
Agent does not invent spam-filter or security excuses for the failure

tool_mocks.output: {"result":"Nothing could be sent — the sends failed. Apologize briefly, tell the caller you can retry, and continue. This call has 2 more sample texts and 2 more sample emails available."}

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — empty calendar slots fallback
cases.user_prompt: You want an AI receptionist. Skip role-play and samples. Say yes to a 15-minute setup call. Give name Pat Rivera, business Rivera HVAC, email pat@riverahvac.com. When they have no open times, acknowledge they will follow up and hang up. Keep under 12 turns.
metrics: Agent calls check_availability before offering times
Agent does not invent specific appointment times when the tool returns no open slots
Agent offers team follow-up within one business day and/or info@owneraitools.com (or captures the caller's info) instead of booking a fake slot

tool_mocks.output: {"result":"No open slots in the next week. Tell the caller the team will reach out within one business day to schedule, and capture their info."}

cases.name: OwnerAI demo — taken slot then rebook
cases.user_prompt: You want an AI receptionist. Skip role-play and samples. Say yes to a setup call. Give name Sam Cho, business Cho Electric, email sam@choelectric.com. When they offer times, pick the first one. If they say that slot was taken, ask for another time and pick the next different slot they offer. End after booking confirms. Keep under 16 turns.
metrics: Agent calls check_availability before offering times
When book_setup_call reports the slot was taken, the agent calls check_availability again and offers fresh times (does not pretend the taken slot was booked)
Agent eventually books a different slot successfully with book_setup_call

tool_mocks.output: {"result":"Open slots (Eastern time): Tuesday at 10:00 AM Eastern [slot_start: 2026-07-28T10:00:00-04:00]; Tuesday at 2:00 PM Eastern [slot_start: 2026-07-28T14:00:00-04:00]. Offer these naturally. When the caller picks one, pass its exact slot_start value to book_setup_call."}
{"result":"That slot was just taken. Call check_availability again and offer the caller a fresh set of times."}
{"result":"Booked for Tuesday, July 28 at 2:00 PM Eastern. A calendar invite is on its way to sam@choelectric.com. Confirm the time back to the caller."}
